### Samson’s Spectacular Sin
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/samsons-spectacular-sin
Passage: Judges 14:3
Points:
- Samson followed his own carnal impulses rather than godly wisdom when insisting on a Philistine wife.
- His demand that she was right in his eyes exposes sinful self-reliance and spiritual rebellion.
- Samson's parents displayed weak spiritual discernment by failing to firmly restrain his rash decision.
- Despite human foolishness and moral compromise, God remained in sovereign control over every circumstance.
- The Lord miraculously used Samson's flawed actions to accomplish His redemptive deliverance against Israel's oppressors.

### Samson Breaks His Vow
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/samson-breaks-his-vow
Passage: Judges 14:4
Points:
- Samson compromised his calling from birth by pursuing an illicit marriage outside the faith of Israel.
- Although God never authored Samson's transgression, human sin never falls outside His sovereign decree.
- The Lord utilized Samson's flawed desire to establish an opportunity to strike down the Philistines.
- God’s ability to work through sinful actions does not exempt sinners from suffering the consequences.
- Believers are urged to walk in obedience rather than bringing avoidable sorrow through compromise.
